description.value: LOINC Answer List LL2972-9 codes for ABO and Rh blood group types.
The availability status of a Cord Blood Unit (CBU) in the NMDP registry. Conveyed as a simple string value (e.g., 'Available').
The registration status of a donor in the NMDP registry. Conveyed as a simple string value (e.g., 'Available', 'Temporarily Unavailable', 'Active', 'Permanently Unavailable').
An example hemoglobin observation for a Cord Blood Unit (14.2 g/dL).
An example high resolution typing order for a Cord Blood Unit. Subject is the recipient, performer is the CBU.
An example Cord Blood Unit (CBU) registered in the NMDP registry, demonstrating all CBU identifier slices and demographics.
A donor who is deceased, demonstrating the donor-status extension with Permanently Unavailable.
A donor who is temporarily unavailable (e.g., post-collection).
An example ABO/Rh blood group observation for a donor (O Positive).
An example body weight observation for a donor (82 kg).
An example CMV IgG antibody observation for a donor (Negative).
An example confirmatory typing order for an NMDP donor. Subject is the recipient, performer is the donor.
An example blood specimen (EDTA tube) collected from a donor for HLA confirmatory typing.
A donor with a GRID identifier and no source ID yet assigned.
An example HLA-A genotype observation showing a donor typed as HLA-A*02:01+HLA-A*03:01.
An example HLA-B genotype observation showing a donor typed as HLA-B*07:02+HLA-B*44:02.
An example HLA-C genotype observation showing a donor typed as HLA-C*07:01+HLA-C*05:01.
An example HLA-DRB1 genotype observation showing a donor typed as HLA-DRB1*15:01+HLA-DRB1*03:01.
An example infectious disease marker testing order for a donor prior to collection.
A synthetic example patient used to demonstrate the starter profile.
An example donor registered in the NMDP registry.
An example donor center in the NMDP network.
An example recipient patient identified by RID and local ID. Used as the subject of donor and CBU orders.
Genotype List String Codes from glstring.org. Codes represent HLA genotypes in GL String format (e.g., hla#3.25.0#HLA-A*01:01:01:01+HLA-A*01:02).
A minimal Patient profile used as the starting point for MatchSync donor data.
An observation representing a donor or CBU's ABO and Rh blood group type. Uses LOINC 882-1 and valueCodeableConcept with codes from LOINC Answer List LL2972-9.
An observation representing a donor's body weight. Uses LOINC 29463-7 and valueQuantity in kg.

A profile representing a Cord Blood Unit (CBU) workup order in the NMDP system. CBU orders can include high resolution typing for individual loci or a full panel. ServiceRequest.subject references the recipient Patient, and ServiceRequest.performer references the CBU Patient.
Types of centers in the NMDP network.
All center types in the NMDP network.
An observation representing a donor or CBU's CMV IgG antibody presence status. Uses LOINC 22244-8 and valueCodeableConcept with text-only values (Positive, Negative, Inconclusive, Untested).
Text-based status codes for CMV IgG antibody presence in donor and CBU testing.
Allowable text-based values for CMV IgG antibody presence status used in NMDP donor and CBU payloads.

A profile representing a Cord Blood Unit (CBU) in the NMDP registry. CBUs are identified by having a cbu-source-id identifier (no GRID). CBUs are not tied to a real person — they represent a cord blood unit. The Patient.id should be the CBU source ID.
Describes the expected capabilities of the NMDP Donor API FHIR server, including supported resources, interactions, and search parameters.

A profile representing a donor workup order in the NMDP system. For donors, the ordered item is always confirmatory typing. ServiceRequest.subject references the recipient Patient, and ServiceRequest.performer references the donor Patient.
A profile representing a hematopoietic cell donor registered in the NMDP registry. Donors are identified by having an NMDP GRID identifier. The Patient.id should be the GRID value.

A profile representing a testing specimen (blood tube, buccal swab, etc.) collected from a donor for HLA typing or infectious disease marker testing. Specimens are identified by Order Number + Donor GRID rather than individual specimen IDs.

Status codes for NMDP registered donors. These codes represent the enterprise Registry Status maintained by NMDP, indicating a donor's availability for patient search, matching, and product request activities. Source: ODS DonorWithSampleResponse (v05). In FHIR Donor API payloads, donor status is conveyed as a valueString on the donor-status extension.
All registry status codes for NMDP registered donors. Maps to ODS enterprise donor status values (AV, TU, AC, DE).
An observation representing a CBU's hemoglobin level. Uses LOINC 718-7 (Hemoglobin [Mass/volume] in Blood) and valueQuantity in g/dL.

name.value: NMDP HLA Gene Name Code System

description.value: HGNC Gene IDs for HLA loci used in donor typing. Subset of HGNC relevant to NMDP operations.

name.value: NMDP HLA Gene Name Value Set

description.value: HLA gene names (HGNC IDs) for loci typed in NMDP donor operations.

A profile for HLA genotype observations. Each instance represents a genotype for a single HLA locus, expressed as a GL String Code. The Observation.code uses a locus-specific LOINC code identifying which HLA gene was typed.

name.value: NMDP HLA Locus LOINC Value Set

description.value: LOINC codes for HLA locus-specific high resolution typing observations used in NMDP donor and CBU payloads.
A profile for Infectious Disease Marker (IDM) orders. IDM testing is required for donor clearance before stem cell collection.
Codes identifying the type of donor or CBU workup order in the NMDP system.
All codes from the NMDP Order Type code system.
An organization participating in the NMDP network (donor centers, transplant centers, collection centers, apheresis centers).
Codes identifying the type of specimen collected from a donor for HLA typing or infectious disease marker testing.
All specimen type codes for donor testing samples in the NMDP system.
